subject: Confirmation of Event Registration
body: Dear attendee, Thank you for registering for our upcoming webinar on 'Digital Marketing Strategies'. The event will take place on Friday, July 23rd, at 10:00 AM. Please make sure to mark your calendar and join us on time to gain valuable insights and network with industry experts. We look forward to your participation. Should you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our customer support team at events@example.com. Best regards, The Event Planning Team
